name: dry_run:span-frontend-get-static:d5f875f1
query:
fetch spans, from: -24h, samplingRatio: 100
| filter service.name == "frontend"
| summarize scope_records = count() * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    target_records = countIf(service.name == "frontend" and span.name == "GET /static/*") * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    matched_records = countIf(service.name == "frontend" and span.name == "GET /static/*") * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    outside_target = countIf((service.name == "frontend" and span.name == "GET /static/*") and not (service.name == "frontend" and span.name == "GET /static/*")) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio)
